skills.name: Moon Slash (曜断)
skills.description: Takiyasha Hime wields Moonlight Glaive to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her attack. ; : ;New Moon Blessing (新月の祝福) :'''General, Mark''': Gain 20% crit resist per New Moon Blessing. At end of turn, convert 1 stack of New Moon Blessing into 20% increased damage. :''(The 5 crescent moons circling around her will change into full moons, 1 full moon represents 1 converted stack of New Moon Blessing.)'' ;Crit Resist :Source of damage has its crit reduced.

skills.name: Moon's Secrets (月の奥義)
skills.description:
Toggles through the different modes of Moon's Secrets. At the start of battle, Takiyasha Hime will have the effect of Ignis added to her attacks.
This skill is also used to switch between Shadowless Sun and Sleepless Moon.

skills.name: Ignis (侵掠)
skills.description: Allows Takiyasha Hime to ignore 180 of the enemy's defense when attacking enemies with more than 50% HP.

skills.name: Aqua (飛流)
skills.description: Allows each of Takiyasha Hime's attacks to dispel 1 buff from an enemy. If no buff was dispelled, the enemy's move bar is decreased by 5% instead.

skills.name: Aer (疾風)
skills.description: Allows Takiyasha Hime's damage dealt to be increased by 30% when attacking enemies with less than 50%.

skills.name: Terra (不動)
skills.description:
Prevents damage from Takiyasha Hime's attacks from triggering enemy's souls. Grants her Moon Shelter, lasts for 1 turn.
;Moon Shelter
:Same as Shelter. Blocks all control effects or Banish and similar effects from a single skill, includes self-inflicted control effects.

skills.name: Shadowless Sun (夕日無影)
skills.description:
One of the Moon's Secrets. Takiyasha Hime commands a legion of ghost knights to charge at all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 12%, 24% and 99% of her attack with each hit respectively.
This skill can also be switched to Sleepless Moon with Moon's Secrets.

upgrades.text: Damage of the third hit increases to 109%.
Damage of the third hit increases to 118%.
Damage of the third hit increases to 127%.
Damage of the third hit increases to 136%.

skills.name: Sleepless Moon (不眠の朧月)
skills.description:
One of the Moon's Secrets. Takiyasha Hime focuses her spiritual power and launches a Moon Slash to inflict 5 hits on an enemy, dealing damage equal to 50% of her attack with each hit.
This skill can also be switched to Shadowless Sun with Moon's Secrets.

bio.condition: In PVP, Practice or Spar, use every mode of Moon's Secrets and win.
Donate 1 Takiyasha Hime shard in guild.
